description: Which statistical leaderboards exist for a sport, with the path to each one plus the national and in-scope averages and the games-played minimum. **Call this before maxpreps_get_stat_leaderboard** — the leaf path is not derivable from the stat name (Total TDs lives at `touchdowns/tot-tds`, Sacks at `sacks/tot-sacks`), so the path must come from here. Read-only.

season.description: Season label, e.g. 25-26. Omit for the current season.

sport.description: Sport slug as used in MaxPreps URLs, e.g. football

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. NC. Omit for national leaders.

name: maxpreps_list_stat_categories
title: List MaxPreps stat leaderboard categories
